mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settings_shortcut ( id, command_trigger, reference_trigger, component_trigger, slide_trigger, snippet_trigger, previous_slide, next_slide, zoom_in, zoom_out, toggle_overview, export_deck, toggle_view, toggle_source, switch_theme, submit_request, select_suggestion ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{commandTrigger}, #{referenceTrigger}, #{componentTrigger}, #{slideTrigger}, #{snippetTrigger}, #{previousSlide}, #{nextSlide}, #{zoomIn}, #{zoomOut}, #{toggleOverview}, #{exportDeck}, #{toggleView}, #{toggleSource}, #{switchTheme}, #{submitRequest}, #{selectSuggestion} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET command_trigger = excluded.command_trigger, reference_trigger = excluded.reference_trigger, component_trigger = excluded.component_trigger, slide_trigger = excluded.slide_trigger, snippet_trigger = excluded.snippet_trigger, previous_slide = excluded.previous_slide, next_slide = excluded.next_slide, zoom_in = excluded.zoom_in, zoom_out = excluded.zoom_out, toggle_overview = excluded.toggle_overview, export_deck = excluded.export_deck, toggle_view = excluded.toggle_view, toggle_source = excluded.toggle_source, switch_theme = excluded.switch_theme, submit_request = excluded.submit_request, select_suggestion = excluded.select_suggestion
